correctness.rationale: Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify_jam.py (exit 0, ALL CERTIFICATES PASS). Independently re-enumerated contacts with separate code: brute-force scan finds exactly the 41 claimed pairs and 14 claimed walls within |dist^2-(2r)^2|<=2e-12 / |wall gap|<=2e-12 (max pair squared-error 4.4e-13, max wall error 0). Completeness margin verified: every other backbone pair/wall and every rattler gap clears by >=3e-4 in exact Fraction arithmetic; float cross-check gives min non-contact pair gap 3.72e-4 (rattlers 27-28) and min backbone-only non-contact gap 9.15e-4, min non-contact wall gap 0.00493, so the 3e-4 margin holds with small but positive slack. Rank: Bareiss 54x54 minor determinant nonzero (445-digit numerator) replayed; independent rank checks mod p=1000003 and p=1000033 both give rank 54, and float SVD gives 54 singular values with min 0.0159 >> 0. Stress: Bareiss solve with w[54]=1 yields all 55 entries >0 (min 0.369) with entrywise R^T w=0 in Fractions, replayed; float solve confirms all>0 with residual 1.8e-15. Sign convention audited: pair rows (dx,dy)/(-dx,-dy) have the sign of the gap-opening rate up to positive factor 1/|dx|, and wall rows (+/-1) match gap derivatives, so the Connelly-type lemma (w>0, R^T w=0 implies no v with Rv strictly >0 componentwise) is correctly applied. Claim is explicitly first-order jamming of the committed rational configuration, not global optimality and not nonlinear neighbourhood exclusion (admitted fallback scope, limitations stated). No essential inference, boundary case, or computation fails.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Live Packomania table checked: N=1..30 radii bold (proven optimal) while N=31 radius 0.089338333351 non-bold heuristic with 55 contacts / 4 loose; N=36 also bold but N=31 is the smallest open case. Fetched csq31.txt (31 centers) matches the embedded decimals exactly, and contacts.txt/loose.txt give only bare counts (55/4) with no rigidity-matrix rank, no equilibrium stress, and no jamming proof. Nearest substantive priors cover different objects/methods: Musin-Nikitenko arXiv:1212.0649 proves N=6,7,8 optima on the square flat torus via irreducible contact graphs (different container, settled small cases); Smirnov-Voloshinov torus N=9 global B&B (~2000 CPU-hours) is a different expensive global method; Connelly-Zhang flexible-radii rigidity theory gives the general first-order/dual-stress criterion but no instantiated N=31 square backbone, rank, or explicit positive stress. Counts plus coordinates do not mechanically imply full column rank plus strict positivity of the 1-dimensional null vector; positivity required an actual solve and is a new computed fact. No source publishes the 41+14 contact list with full-rank certificate plus strictly positive stress for the N=31 square backbone.

value.rationale: Headline claim judged separately from the unclosed neighbourhood-exclusion survey step, which is honestly disclaimed. The fallback-level headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object: the 27-circle backbone of the smallest open equal-circle-in-square packing (N=31), with exact contact classification (41+14=55), full-rank 55x54 rigidity matrix, and explicit strictly positive equilibrium stress proving first-order collective jamming. Object and invariant were motivated before computation (Packomania bold/non-bold frontier; Fejes Toth/Kuperberg/Connelly packing-versus-rigidity programs); the value (first jammed-backbone certificate at the exact frontier where square optimality becomes open) is not known or mechanically implied by published counts/coordinates; a future researcher could reasonably need the precise contact list, rank, and stress witness for rigidity analysis and packing-versus-jamming benchmarks. This is one exact order/constant/witness-type datum of the kind eligible under the value standard, with mathematical interpretation (jamming lemma) supplied. It is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration. Certification alone is not the sole basis — frontier position plus reusable witness provides the value.

decisive_checks: Replayed output/artifacts/verify_jam.py: exit 0, C1/C2 41+14 exact with >=3e-4 clearances, C3 54x54 minor det nonzero (445-digit numerator), C4 all-55 stress >0 with R^T w=0, C5 lemma.
Independent brute-force contact enumeration with separate code: pairs-within-tol == claimed 41-set; walls-within-tol == claimed 14-set; max pair squared-error 4.4e-13 <= 2e-12; wall error 0.
Exact margin cross-check: min non-contact pair gap 3.72e-4 (rattlers 27-28), backbone-only min 9.15e-4, wall min 0.00493 — all above 3e-4 threshold.
Rank cross-checks: mod-1000003 rank 54, mod-1000033 rank 54, float SVD min singular value 0.0159 (full column rank).
Stress cross-check: float solve R55^T w=0 with w55=1 gives all>0 (min 0.369, max 25.73), residual max 1.8e-15; nullspace is 1-dimensional (55x54 rank 54) so positivity is the nontrivial content.
Sign-convention audit: pair/wall rows have sign of gap-opening rates; first-order lemma correctly stated and explicitly limited to infinitesimal jamming.
Embedded-vs-fetched coordinate comparison: all 31 centers match Packomania csq31.txt to 1e-15.
residual_risks: Tightest clearance is 3.72e-4 (rattler pair 27-28) versus the 3e-4 threshold — proof passes exactly but margin is thin; a different rounding of the heuristic coordinates could change rattler classification.

Certificate concerns the committed 12-decimal rational configuration (contact error up to 4.4e-13 in squared distance), not a true real-optimal packing; decimal truncation means the physical heuristic packing differs at ~1e-12 level.
First-order (infinitesimal) jamming only; no nonlinear neighbourhood-exclusion box is closed, so finite-perturbation stability and global N=31 optimality are explicitly not established.
Rattler labeling is relative to committed coordinates; rattlers could jam under large perturbations — irrelevant to backbone claim but limits reuse scope.
